note: Single source for tool id -> display name (TOKE-12). The dashboard (src/utils/toolDisplayName.ts), the desktop widget (src/components/widget/cardModel.ts) and the static wallpaper (src-tauri/src/wallpaper.rs tool_display_name) all read this file. Lookup: trim with the ECMAScript WhiteSpace+LineTerminator set, lower-case, then names[id], else names[aliases[id]], else capitalize the first character of the trimmed original. An empty name uses emptyLabel. Spellings follow the Chinese UI's existing brand names (OpenCode, MiniMax); they are not translations. Scanner tool ids are not rewritten. reasonix is the one registered id whose previous fallback spelling (Reasonix) disagreed with the repo's own ReasoniX.
